attorneys: Joseph L. Alioto, Matthew P. Mitchell, and Robert W. Hughes for petitioner., John H. Schafer for Continental Baking Co.; Peter W. Billings and James R. opinions.text:
C. A. 10th Cir. Certiorari denied.

Mr. Justice Douglas is of the opinion that certiorari should be granted. The Chief Justice took no part in the consideration or decision of this petition.
